name: Activity Selection
description: Selects maximum number of non-overlapping activities from a set, each with a start and end time. Greedy choice: always pick the activity that finishes earliest.
aim: Maximize the number of activities that can be performed by always choosing the activity with the earliest finish time that does not conflict with previously selected activities.
howItWorks: Sort all activities by finish time
For each remaining activity: if start ≥ end of last selected, select it

complexity.spaceDescription: In-place after sorting — only track last selected activity end time

realWorld: Classroom scheduling — max events in a room
Sports event planning — maximize games on one field
Interval scheduling maximization in operations research
whenToUse: When greedy choice (earliest finish) provably optimal
alternatives: Dynamic programming — needed for weighted activities (maximize total value)
Network flow — for more complex scheduling constraints
Sweep line algorithm — for detecting overlaps

inputHint: Pairs of numbers, each pair one activity as (start, end).
